name: Bruges
tagline: A fairy-tale medieval town of canals
summary: Bruges is one of Europe's best-preserved medieval towns: cobbled lanes, gabled houses, quiet canals and a towering belfry. It's a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the home of Flemish Primitive painting, lace, chocolate and beer.
seasonNote: Day-trippers crowd the centre from late morning; stay overnight for quiet evenings. Christmas markets in December.
arrival: Trains from Brussels take about 1 hour, and from Ghent 25 minutes.
gettingAround: Walk or cycle; canal boats run from several jetties.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; carry a few euros for fries stands and markets.
foodTip: Mussels and fries, Flemish stew and waffles.
